description: This file defines a composable component for handling base64-encoded images within an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It manages the decoding process and state management for displaying images.

classes.name: Base64ImageState
classes.description: Data class holding the image bitmap and a failure indicator for decoding process.

methods.name: rememberBase64ImageState
methods.description: Composable function that manages the state of a base64 image, decoding it asynchronously and updating UI state.
